verdict.rationale: The evidence shows MailerLite exposes itself to external AI assistants, via an MCP connection and natural-language prompts inside Claude. That is an outside assistant acting on MailerLite, not an AI assistant built into the product. The only built-in AI mention is a landing-page 'AI builder', a narrow generation feature rather than a general assistant you can hand tasks to, so it is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
